programs.name: Virginia Housing Down Payment Assistance Grant

amount.text: 2% of the lesser of sales price or appraised value with a conventional bond loan, 2.5% with an FHA bond loan; down payment only

programs.firstTimeNote: repeat buyers only in Areas of Economic Opportunity
programs.quote: The Down Payment Assistance Grant is a true grant, meaning you never need to repay it.

programs.name: Virginia Housing Plus Second Mortgage

amount.text: up to 5% of the purchase price, depending on credit score and first-mortgage type

programs.repayment: 30-year fixed-rate second mortgage with monthly payments, no prepayment penalty; cannot be combined with the grant
